daily_summary: 当日三个 commit 分别聚焦于：清理已失效的 out-of-tree backend 测试（沿用新 entry_points 插件机制前的遗留代码）、修复 CPU 解释器中浮点转换的舍入模式丢失与 RTNE 位运算逻辑错误（含 bf16/fp8 的 tie/carry/subnormal 边界）、以及修复 FileCacheManager.put_group/get_group 使用绝对路径导致缓存目录搬迁后失效的问题。整体方向为测试清理、解释器数值正确性修复和编译缓存可移植性修复，均非架构性变更，但涉及的 interpreter.py 与 cache.py 属于 triton-ascend 复用的通用路径。
ascend_impact_summary: 当日变更中，commit 1e4b57beb3a6 删除的是已废弃的 out-of-tree backend 测试（triton.common.backend 早已被 entry_points 插件机制取代），仅影响 test/CI，不影响 triton-ascend；commit 6fe3348e6e90 修改了 python/triton/runtime/interpreter.py 的 `_convert_float` 与 `InterpreterBuilder.cast_impl/create_fp_to_fp` 签名，而 triton-ascend 的 AscendInterpreterBuilder/AscendReduceOps/AscendScanOps 继承该 InterpreterBuilder 并依赖解释执行协议，同时其 monkey-patch 亦关注 semantic/code_generator 路径；该变更虽不改变抽象基类接口但改变了浮点转换语义与 cast_impl 可选参数，Ascend 的 CPU 解释执行 Ascend kernel 在 bf16/fp8 转换结果上可能与上游解释器行为不一致，需评估测试；commit 745efac57446 修改了 python/triton/runtime/cache.py 的 FileCacheManager 组缓存存储格式（绝对路径改为相对 cache_dir 的名称），属于通用缓存路径，可能影响 triton-ascend 编译产物的磁盘缓存命中与 Group 读取，但由于 triton-ascend 主要走自己的编译阶段且缓存键包含 triton_key()，实际风险较低。总体而言，对 triton-ascend 无破坏性接口变更，主要是解释器数值语义与缓存格式的兼容性观察点。

commits.comment: 删除自 2024 年 #2887 移除 triton/common 后即无法被 pytest 收集的死测试 python/test/backend/test_device_backend.py 及其辅助 C 源文件 extension_backend.c，并把 AMD CI 从点名 test_mir_stage.py 改为整个 python/test/backend/ 目录。该测试原本覆盖已被 entry_points 插件机制取代的 register_backend()/compute_core_version_key()/ExtensionBackend 等旧 API，且依赖已变为空文件的 triton/compiler/make_launcher.py，同时 BaseBackend 的抽象方法集已扩展到 6 个（add_stages 只是其中之一），旧测试与新契约完全不匹配。因此这是纯粹的测试遗留清理，属于 test/chore 范畴，不触碰任何生产代码、抽象接口或运行时路径，风险极低。若未来需要覆盖 out-of-tree backend 注册，应针对 entry_points 发现机制（_discover_backends/_find_concrete_subclasses）另写新测试。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。该 commit 仅删除失效的 out-of-tree backend 测试与 CI 目标调整，未修改 python/triton/backends/__init__.py 的发现机制、BaseBackend/DriverBase 契约或任何 Python 运行时/编译器实现。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。triton-ascend 使用自己的 third_party/ascend 后端注册（entry_points group='triton.backends' + TRITON_PLUGIN_DIRS）与独立的 third_party/ascend/unittest 测试体系，删除的 python/test/backend/test_device_backend.py 与 Ascend 无关。

commits.message:
[TEST] Remove the dead out-of-tree backend test (#12097)

`python/test/backend/test_device_backend.py` has not been collectable
since
#2887 (Jan 2024) removed `triton/common`. It imports
`triton.common.backend`,
so collecting `python/test/backend/` fails outright -- which is why
88771e23f8
had to point AMD CI at `test_mir_stage.py` by name rather than at the
directory.

This is not a stale import path. The test was added in #1643 to cover
`register_backend()`, and #2887 replaced that mechanism wholesale with
the
standard plugin interface:

- `register_backend()` and `compute_core_version_key()` are gone;
backends are
  discovered via entry points and the `triton/backends/` package.
- `BaseBackend` moved to `triton.backends.compiler` and now takes a
`GPUTarget`
  rather than a `device_type` string.
- Of the six abstract methods `BaseBackend` declares today,
`ExtensionBackend`
  implements only `add_stages`.
- `triton/compiler/make_launcher.py`, the source of its
`make_so_cache_key`
  import, is now an empty file.

Reviving this coverage means writing a new test against entry-point
discovery --
a different test, not a repair of this one. If there is appetite for
keeping
out-of-tree backend registration under test, I'm happy to pursue that
instead.

The second commit points the AMD job at `python/test/backend/` now that
the
directory collects again. No behaviour change today: `test_mir_stage.py`
is the
only file left there.

commits.comment: 修复 CPU 解释器浮点转换的两个正确性缺陷：(1) cast_impl 默认丢弃 RTNE 舍入模式（fp32→bf16 会截断而非就近舍入），且 fp16↔bf16 通过 fp32 中转也受影响；现在 cast_impl 接受 rounding_mode 参数并在 create_fp_trunc 中显式传入 RTNE，同时删除 fp16↔bf16 的中间 fp32 两次转换路径，直接走 _convert_float。(2) 重写 _convert_float 的 RTNE 逻辑：原来 cut_off 只判断是否置位（ties away from zero）且未处理尾数进位，导致 fp8 舍入错误；新实现将隐藏位纳入 full_significand，对齐 subnormal 结果后再舍入，正确处理 ties-to-even、进位传播到指数、溢出/非有限值（NaN payload、inf）以及 FNUZ 格式的零/NaN 编码。这属于 interpreter.py 的数值语义修复，涉及 InterpreterBuilder.cast_impl 签名和 create_fp_to_fp（不再做 fp16↔bf16 两级转换）。由于 triton-ascend 的 AscendInterpreterBuilder 继承 InterpreterBuilder 并复写相关 op 执行逻辑，此变更改变了 float cast 的调用/语义约定。风险中等：解释器内部行为变化可能使 Ascend 上 CPU 解释执行结果与硬件端结果或上游参考不一致，但不会导致 import/继承链断裂（cast_impl 新增参数带默认值，属向后兼容）。

ascend_impact.functionality: python/triton/runtime/interpreter.py 是 triton-ascend 的 AscendInterpreterBuilder（third_party/ascend/backend/ascend_interpreter.py, 继承 InterpreterBuilder）与 AscendReduceOps/AscendScanOps 的基类实现。本 commit 修改了 InterpreterBuilder.cast_impl 的签名（新增可选参数 rounding_mode=None，向后兼容）与 create_fp_to_fp 内部逻辑（移除 fp16↔bf16 经 fp32 中转、统一走 _convert_float），并重写了模块级 _convert_float 的 RTNE/进位/subnormal 逻辑。Ascend 解释器若复用基类 cast_impl/create_fp_to_fp，其 bf16/fp8 cast 结果将随上游一起变更为正确的 RTNE 语义；若 Ascend 覆写了这些方法，则需要对齐 _convert_float 新语义以保证与上游一致。未涉及 BaseBackend/DriverBase 等后端契约接口，无破坏性签名变更。
ascend_impact.testing: triton-ascend 的 third_party/ascend/unittest/（含 pytest_ut/ 与解释执行路径测试）中涉及 bf16/fp8 cast 的用例在完全走基类实现时可能因语义修正而后端结果变化；需要核对是否依赖旧的截断/ties-away 行为。上游新增的 test_cast_bf16_rounding、test_cast_fp8_rounding（python/test/unit/language/test_core.py）与 test_float_conversion_subnormal_rounding（python/test/unit/runtime/test_interpreter.py）为解释器舍入模式提供了参考测试模板。

commits.message:
[INTERPRETER] Preserve cast rounding modes and fix shared RTNE (#12028)

The interpreter dropped the default RTNE mode when casting fp32 to bf16,
truncating instead of rounding. The fp16-to-bf16 path was also affected
through its fp32 intermediate.

```python
x.to(tl.bfloat16)
```

| Input | Interpreter before this change | Expected RTNE |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| fp32 `1.99999` | 1.9921875 | 2.0 |
| fp16 `65504.0` | 65280.0 | 65536.0 |

Forward rounding modes through `cast_impl`, including RTNE for default
narrowing conversions.

The shared `_convert_float` RTNE logic also rounded ties up and
mishandled mantissa carry. For example, an fp32 `1.9990234375` cast to
fp8e5 became `1.0` instead of `2.0`. Fix ties-to-even, propagate carry
into the exponent, and align subnormal results before rounding.

Adds bf16 rounding-mode tests, fp8 tie/carry boundary tests, and exact
subnormal bit-pattern tests.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: The commit rewrites the body of `_convert_float` in python/triton/runtime/interpreter.py and changes `cast_impl`'s signature to `(self, src, dst_type, rounding_mode=None)`, plus routes `create_fp_trunc` through `cast_impl(..., _ir.ROUNDING_MODE.RTNE)` and removes the fp16<->bf16 two-step intermediate path in `create_fp_to_fp`. triton-ascend does not override these in third_party/ascend/backend/ascend_interpreter.py (AscendInterpreterBuilder inherits cast_impl/create_fp_to_fp/create_fp_trunc unchanged, and `ascend_cast_impl` in third_party/ascend/language/cann/extension/vec_ops.py only calls create_fp_to_fp/create_fp_trunc/create_fp_ext with unchanged 2-arg signatures, so the code change itself is backward-compatible). The real impact is that triton-ascend maintains a build-time patch `third_party/ascend/patch/triton-ascend-3.6.0.patch` containing 3 hunks that modify `_convert_float` to (1) mark NaN via `input_nan_index = (exponent == (1<<input_exponent_width)-1) & (significand != 0)`, (2) compute `overflow_index = exponent_unclamped > output_max_exponent - 1` and (3) force overflow to inf via `significand_output[overflow_index & ~input_nan_index] = 0`. All 3 hunks are anchored to the OLD body (the `# Prevent overflow and underflow` block and the downcast/underflow sections that this commit deletes/replaces), so they will fail to apply cleanly when the patch is reapplied on top of this commit. Required adaptation: re-derive these 3 `_convert_float` hunks against the new implementation. Most of the Ascend patch's intent is now subsumed upstream — the new code already detects `nonfinite`/`input_nan` and converts overflow to inf (RTNE branch: `exponent_output[overflow]=max_exponent; significand_output[overflow]=0`) and NaN to NaN. However, semantic parity must be verified because (a) upstream gates the nonfinite/overflow handling behind `if not input_dtype.is_fp8() and not output_dtype.is_fp8()`, whereas the Ascend patch was unconditional, and (b) upstream's non-RTNE branch clamps overflow to largest-finite (`exponent_output=max_exponent-1; significand_output=all-ones`) instead of inf, differing from Ascend's always-inf behavior. Likely the 3 hunks can be dropped or reduced to a minimal guard, followed by running the Ascend interpreter tests (third_party/ascend/unittest) to confirm overflow->inf and NaN propagation semantics are preserved for fp8 and non-fp8 casts.

commits.comment: 修复 FileCacheManager 在缓存目录被搬移或复制后失效的问题（#11999）：put_group 原先把每个子文件的完整绝对路径写入 __grp__<name>.json，get_group 又按该绝对路径精确查找，导致缓存目录搬迁后全部 miss 并触发全量重编译。现在 put_group 改为按文件名（sorted(group)）存储子文件，get_group 通过 _make_path 与 cache_dir 拼接；同时保留对旧格式全路径子项及 cache_dir 之外子文件（_make_path 对绝对路径直接返回）的兼容，因此无需迁移数据。这是 python/triton/runtime/cache.py 的通用缓存修复，与 RemoteCacheManager.put_group 的既有行为对齐，并新增两个单测。属于 bugfix，风险低，但改变了 __grp__ json 的 child_paths 内容语义——任何外部工具读取该 json 的假定需注意。

ascend_impact.functionality: python/triton/runtime/cache.py 位于‘可能影响’路径（python/triton/runtime/cache.py：编译产物磁盘缓存与 code_cache 键格式变更可能影响 Ascend kernel 的缓存命中，但属于通用路径影响）。本 commit 修改了 FileCacheManager.put_group/get_group 的存储格式（子文件绝对路径 → 相对 cache_dir 的名称），使缓存目录可搬迁/复制。triton-ascend 的编译产物缓存复用该 FileCacheManager（AscendBackend.add_stages 产出的 npubin/mlirbc 等通过缓存落地），因此缓存目录被搬移后也能正确命中，属正向改进；若 Ascend 侧或外部脚本曾按全路径解析 __grp__ json，则需适配。
ascend_impact.testing: triton-ascend 若存在缓存相关的端到端或 CI 测试（如依赖第三方向缓存、跨构建复用缓存目录），需验证搬迁后 Group 读取仍正确；上游新增的 test_file_cache_manager_get_group_relocated_dir 与 test_file_cache_manager_get_group_accepts_full_child_paths 可作为参考。
suggested_test_areas: third_party/ascend/unittest/（缓存/编译产物复用相关用例）

commits.message:
[RUNTIME] Store file cache group children relative to the cache dir (#12001)

fixes #11999

`FileCacheManager.put_group` wrote the full path of every child into
`__grp__<name>.json`, and `get_group` looked up those exact paths. so a
cache dir only worked where it was built: copy it somewhere else, remove
the original and every lookup misses and triton recompiles everything.

now `put_group` stores children that live in the cache dir by name like
`RemoteCacheManager.put_group` already does and `get_group` joins them
with the cache dir. full paths from older group files and children
outside the cache dir still work. nothing needs migrating, since the key
includes `triton_key()` and a different triton build never reads these
files.

added `test_file_cache_manager_get_group_relocated_dir` and
`test_file_cache_manager_get_group_accepts_full_child_paths`.

checked on an A100 with triton 3.8.0 (its `cache.py` is identical to
main's) with the patched file dropped in:
- the relocated test fails without the patch and passes with it
- `test_cache.py` from 3.8.0: 41 passed, 1 skipped, with and without the
patch
- in the repro from #11999 the plain copy now hits. the script's own
rebase step assumes full paths, so it errors out after that step with
this change
